label: interfaces-idle
title: Service family boundaries
body: This model is explicitly coarse. Route-specific policy and credential checks enter as environment evidence; accepted handler work and returned responses are separate from any domain effect.

label: interface-authorizing
title: Request at service boundary
body: The request carries resolved actor, tenant, family, key and validation evidence. Public source offers bypass tenant/account authority; protected families require their own boundary evidence.

label: interface-running
title: Accepted coarse operation
body: Legacy gate/export, replay, benchmark, ranker, active learning, utility/vector, grants, rewards/missions, account services, analytics and drills retain named family results. Their algorithms are not modeled here.

label: interface-returned
title: Service result returned
body: A read result or domain response has returned. Coarse effects, durable token-bundle receipts and client delivery are separate state; response loss can follow a committed effect.

label: interface-refused
title: Service boundary refused or failed
body: Feature/control gaps, auth/policy validation, load, storage or external failures are explicit inputs. A coarse refusal is not a claim about every route’s exact HTTP status or retry semantics.

label: token-staging
title: Token bundle stages
body: Manifest staging, ready attachments, normal submission acceptance and the durable bundle receipt are separate milestones. Post-submit rescrub or store failure can prevent the bundle receipt.

label: community-snapshot
title: Community publication snapshot
body: Profile publication and withdrawal are separate from snapshot recomputation. Roster reads recheck analytics controls; newly enabled analytics may require recomputing an older snapshot.

label: witness-running
title: Unauthenticated witness request
body: The separate witness service observes two bounded request identities. Work requests consume finite permits; nonce-bound attestation is outside that work limit. Validation outcomes are abstract evidence.

label: witness-returned
title: Witness evidence returned
body: The service returns a nonce-bound quote or a certificate after applicable validation. This model does not prove signatures, enclave identity, redaction quality or inference attestation cryptography.
